avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer that significantly reduces pazopanib plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use concurrently. Allow 2-week washout before starting pazopanib if previously used

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increases pazopanib bioavailability and risk of toxicity
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid completely; may increase pazopanib levels up to 2-fold

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may reduce pazopanib efficacy

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle (Silymarin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May inhibit CYP3A4; potential for increased pazopanib levels
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for increased toxicity signs

caution_supplements.name: Ginger
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild CYP3A4 inhibitory effects at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Moderate amounts likely safe; avoid excessive supplementation

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Significantly increases pazopanib absorption (up to 2-fold increase in Cmax); increases risk of adverse effects
avoid_foods.action: Take pazopanib consistently with or without food; maintain same dietary pattern daily to ensure stable levels

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables (broccoli, cabbage, brussels sprouts)
caution_foods.mechanism: May have mild CYP1A2 inducing properties at very high consumption levels
caution_foods.action: Normal dietary intake is safe; excessive consumption may theoretically reduce levels

caution_foods.name: Charred/grilled foods
caution_foods.action: Consume in moderation; avoid charring of meats

monitoring_notes: Pazopanib should be taken consistently with regard to food (either always with food or always without) to maintain stable plasma concentrations. Monitor for hepatotoxicity, QT prolongation, and hypertension; pazopanib has significant drug-drug interactions via CYP3A4 metabolism, requiring careful evaluation of all concomitant medications and supplements.
